product.name: Graphite pencil, dozen
product.description: The pencils are graphite, a dozen in a sleeve.

blocks.text: The tag on Graphite pencil, dozen was $28.10.
The amount to be billed is fifty one dollars and twenty eight cents.
No packing line is added. Tin clasp at $17.77 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
The label count is the amount you receive.

trick.evidence_text: fifty one dollars and twenty eight cents replaced the lower tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is fifty one dollars and twenty eight cents and the tag was $28.10. Refuse the higher figure.
